title: Waloot
tagline: Payment solution for every day people with a simple onboarding
description:
Our app is designed specifically for non-crypto users, which have zero knowledge about web3. It enables everyone to connect internationally and send money to each other and pay bills without really knowing their transactions are handled on the blockchain. With the simple onboarding of dynamic we enable all web2 users to easily sign in using Oauth or their email. To simplify transactions between users, we added the feature to select a contact and perform transactions using phone numbers.

Features that we want to integrate in the future: 
-	Gasless transactions
-	Users can use their normal fiat payment gateway (Mastercard, Visa, Bank) to make transactions
how_its_made: The frontend is build with nextjs with https://ui.shadcn.com/ for UI components. We integrated dynamic (https://www.dynamic.xyz/) as the wallet provider and customized it's theme & configuration to be the most applicable for web2 users. The app uses the Ethereum Sepolia Testnet only.
